caption: The drawing features a grid of sixteen square blocks arranged in a four-by-four composition centered on a creamy, off-white background. Each block consists of concentric rectangles or strips arranged in a log cabin-style pattern, with the strips radiating outward from a small, dark red square located at the center of each block. The rectangles and strips display a variety of colors and patterns, including shades of pink, purple, green, blue, yellow, brown, orange, and white, along with occasional patterned or textured segments, creating a patchwork effect. The blocks are carefully aligned with each other, forming an overall larger square. A thin, lightly marked scale is present below the grid, along with small hand-written labels, one of which reads “Edith M. Hassler” in the lower left corner.
title: Silk Patchwork for Pillow
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
